name: Gradient-Consistent Quadrilateral Splitting
definition: A dual contouring post-processing step that splits quadrilaterals formed by four neighboring dual vertices into triangles using a gamma parameter derived from gradient consistency or scalar field values.
summary: Gradient-Consistent Quadrilateral Splitting converts quadrilateral meshes to triangles by selecting diagonal splits based on gradient consistency between opposite vertices, using a fixed gamma-based heuristic rather than adaptive geometric criteria.
